name: self-healing-assistant
description: AI-powered self-healing developer assistant: detect runtime errors from logs, generate a fix with OpenAI, and raise a GitHub pull request.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @self-healing/buggy-backend && npm run build --workspace @self-healing/agent
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @self-healing/buggy-backend && npm run typecheck --workspace @self-healing/agent
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @self-healing/agent && npm run test --workspace @self-healing/buggy-backend
